description: Worked owner example (ADR-0007): the operator-authored constraint contract attached to the llm-gateway metric request contract. Deliberately NOT the request schema: regions is a list against request.region (the CEL validator's operator/cardinality pair check), and weight has no request-side counterpart.

regions.description: Regions this Quota covers; compared with membership (request.region in arbitration.regions), never with ==.

weight.description: Arbitration weight consumed by Policy expressions; no request-side counterpart.
